The '''Ividal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ividal sector/Legends|Ividal sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ividal]].
